scope: Batch 2 Q26–50 screened against 450 MBB stems across Sets 1–3; other questions were not semantically audited as new batches.
lexicalMethod: Word TF-IDF, unigrams/bigrams, English stop words, sublinear TF, cosine similarity. Case/whitespace-normalized exact-match screening. No lexical score proves semantic uniqueness.

manualNearDuplicateResolutions.finding: The initial Q26 benefits-verification decision repeated the core task in Batch 1 Q5.
manualNearDuplicateResolutions.resolution: Q26 now tests cross-divisional measurement comparability. Q5 remains byte-preserved.

manualNearDuplicateResolutions.finding: The initial Q40 franchise staffing-rights decision repeated the core task in Q49.
manualNearDuplicateResolutions.resolution: Q40 now tests translation of values into observable service behavior; Q49 tests explicitly stipulated staffing and record obligations.

relatedButDistinctTasks.distinction: Penalties for approved suggestions versus incentive and protected-time design.
Dispersed travel/connectivity participation pilot versus all-shift representation and opportunity selection.
Product-preservation scope safeguards versus volume-aware conservation measures and transparent reporting.

lengthCueScreen.interpretation: A wording-cue screen, not a measure of item difficulty or discrimination. Comparable lengths do not alone establish distractor quality.

empiricalPsychometrics: No candidate-response data analyzed. Item difficulty, discrimination, reliability and differential item functioning have not been estimated. Expert content review and lexical/length heuristics are not empirical calibration.
